subtitle.en-US: Through log and application monitoring, gain insights into system status and proactively manage operations.

description.en-US: Application monitoring is crucial in Websoft9's products, ensuring high availability and performance of systems. Through real-time monitoring, users can promptly detect and respond to anomalies, reducing downtime. Additionally, powerful data analysis and visualization capabilities help teams gain deeper insights into application status, identify potential issues, and optimize performance. Effective application monitoring not only enhances fault response speed but also improves insight into business operations, ensuring user experience and business continuity.
description.zh-CN: 应用监控在 Websoft9 的产品中至关重要，它确保系统的高可用性和性能。通过实时监控，用户能够及时发现并响应异常，减少停机时间。同时，强大的数据分析和可视化能力帮助团队深入理解应用状态，识别潜在问题并优化性能。有效的应用监控不仅提升了故障响应速度，还增强了对业务运行的洞察力，确保用户体验和业务连续性。

subtitle.en-US: Websoft9's workflow automates key processes, enhancing efficiency, stability, and adaptability in application lifecycle management
subtitle.zh-CN: Websoft9 的工作流自动化关键环节，提高了应用生命周期管理的效率、稳定性和适应性

description.en-US: In the Websoft9 platform, the workflow serves as a core mechanism that connects and automates various key aspects, such as continuous deployment, monitoring, cloud resource management, and release. By defining task sequences, the workflow ensures efficiency and consistency in processes, reducing human intervention and thereby lowering the likelihood of errors. In monitoring and resource management, the workflow can dynamically adjust response strategies to ensure system stability under varying loads and optimal resource allocation. Additionally, during the release process, the workflow provides structured version control and rollback mechanisms, enhancing the security of new version deployments. Overall, the application of workflows enhances the flexibility and controllability of the entire lifecycle management, enabling businesses to adapt to changes more rapidly.
description.zh-CN: 在 Websoft9 平台的工作流（workflow）作为核心机制，连接并自动化各个关键环节，如持续部署、监控、云资源管理和发布。通过定义任务序列，工作流确保过程的高效性和一致性，减少人为干预，从而降低错误发生的概率。在监控和资源管理中，工作流能够动态调整响应策略，确保系统在不同负载下的稳定性和资源的最优配置。同时，在发布过程中，工作流提供结构化的版本控制和回滚机制，增强新版本发布的安全性。总体而言，工作流的应用提升了整个生命周期管理的灵活性和可控性，使业务能够更快速地适应变化。

subtitle.en-US: Application lifecycle management, including starting, restarting, and deploying, is managed through a centralized interface
subtitle.zh-CN: 应用的启动、重启、持续部署、终止、删除和域名发布都可以在一个集中界面中进行生命周期管理。

description.en-US: The Websoft9 platform focuses on the subsequent lifecycle management of application artifacts, including key aspects such as deployment, monitoring, and release. With automated deployment tools, users can quickly push application artifacts to the production environment, reducing errors and delays caused by manual operations. At the same time, the platform offers real-time monitoring capabilities, helping users promptly identify and resolve performance issues, ensuring high availability of applications.
description.zh-CN: Websoft9 平台专注于应用制品的后续生命周期管理，包括部署、监控和发布等关键环节。通过自动化部署工具，用户可以快速将应用制品推向生产环境，减少手动操作带来的错误和延迟。同时，平台提供实时监控功能，帮助用户及时识别和解决性能问题，确保应用的高可用性。

description.en-US:
Websoft9 is a Platform as a Service (PaaS) that enables you to run open-source products managed by their official creators on your own cloud or on-premises infrastructure. It offers a seamless experience of deploying applications with just a few clicks, whether on AWS, Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud or HUAIWEICLOUD.

The built-in AppStore from Websoft9 provides more than 200 ready-to-use templates ranging from infrastructure and business to databases, DevOps, AI, web applications, and IoT. This diversity significantly reduces the software's time to market and greatly enhances productivity.

The mission of Websoft9 is to empower innovative organizations and developers to concentrate on using open-source products, while the Websoft9 platform takes care of deployment, integration, updates, CI/CD, and maintenance.

Joining the Websoft9 can unlock an organization's potential for innovation, streamlining technology management and making it simpler and more efficient.
description.zh-CN:
Websoft9（微聚云） 是一个 PaaS 平台，它可以帮助用户在各种云平台上轻松地运行由官方维护的开源应用。不管在 AWS、Azure、GCP 还是阿里云或华为，通过几次点击，即可轻松部署应用程序，有极简的体验。

Websoft9 内置的**应用商店**提供了 200 + 即用型模板，涵盖了云管理、企业软件、通信协作、数据、DevOps、分析、人工智能、物联网等多种类别。它将软件上线的时间由几天减少了几分钟，大大提高了生产力。

Websoft9 的使命是赋能创新型组织和开发者专注于开源应用的使用，而 Websoft9 平台负责应用部署、集成、更新、持续集成/持续部署（CI/CD）和维护。

故，使用 Websoft9 可以释放组织的创新潜力，使技术管理更加流畅、简单和高效。

Websoft9 通过产品和商业级支持服务，与全球主流云平台合作，服务全球 140 多个国家 3000 万云端企业客户。
